SKU level: 81 SKUs sitemap-only, 2 crawl-only, 6632 both; 28 sitemap SKU URLs return 404 and are excluded. Family = category class + catalog name shown on the category card (= 2nd header line of the SKU page), split by the SKU page's product-line header where one catalog name spans several product lines. url = first SKU page of the family in category-page order (the site has no family-level pages); aliases = other SKU pages + /Products/Details/ paths.
